news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
news.summary: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.

news.title: Zcash is about to freeze $16 million in its oldest privacy pool
news.summary: About 12,200 ZEC remains in Sprout, the privacy pool Zcash launched in 2016. Roughly 10,000 coins have left over the past week, but only about 40 moved out Wednesday.

news.title: The pile of lawsuits against Kalshi just grew by one
news.summary: Arkansas has accused the prediction market of running illegal gambling, joining Utah and several other U.S. states that have filed criminal or civil charges.

news.title: XRP Ledger fixes a disclosed bug that could have led to the creation of new tokens
news.summary: The fix went live Wednesday after validator support reset the activation clock in October. XRP itself was unaffected.

news.title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 as Zcash jumps 12% in post-election crypto rebound
news.summary: Ether rose 8% as falling oil prices and a weaker dollar helped markets recover, even as traders weighed a tougher path for U.S. crypto legislation.

news.title: ‘Lawyer up’: Democrats target Trump, Big Tech after midterm sweep
news.summary: Democrats wasted little time after their midterm victory, warning tech CEOs to prepare for subpoenas and signaling fresh investigations into Trump’s business dealings.

news.title: The Digital Chamber calls Sherrod Brown’s win ‘most consequential unfavorable result’ for crypto
news.summary: Democrats are set to reorient the crypto policy debate toward stronger consumer protections and regulatory accountability, the group said.

news.title: Trump Media moves $342 million in bitcoin to Crypto.com, blockchain data show
news.summary: A wallet supposedly linked to Trump Media has made a large BTC transfer to Crypto.com, data tracked by Arkham show.

news.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirms cyberattack after ZachXBT flags $133M in suspected losses
news.summary: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa did not confirm the exact amount of losses but validated the order of magnitude of the $133 million figure.

news.title: India warns AI-powered hackers targeting crypto exchanges at ‘machine speed’
news.summary: India’s cybersecurity agency says a threat actor is escalating an AI-assisted hacking campaign targeting crypto exchanges and other financial firms.

news.title: Mercado Bitcoin says phased reopening to begin Monday, will cover losses
news.summary: Customers will initially be able to view their holdings, while withdrawals and trading remain suspended pending security checks.

news.title: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty
news.summary: Wall Street's push to bring finance onto blockchain rails may continue under existing laws, though the SEC and CFTC face tougher oversight and questions over how long their rules will last, experts said.

news.title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
news.summary: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

news.title: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack
news.summary: The crypto exchange’s founder warned of security staffing shortages amid restructuring as analysts flagged suspicious transfers potentially linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack.

news.title: Crypto PACs eye 2028 ‘new map’ as Democrats take Congress
news.summary: Crypto super PACs spent more than $176 million on the midterms, but the Democratic sweep raises the prospect of tougher industry scrutiny.

news.title: Democratic sweep of Congress forces crypto industry to rethink Washington strategy
news.summary: After two years of a pro-crypto, pro-innovation climate in Washington, the digital asset industry faces a sharp political jolt.

news.title: How Aussie Bitcoiners can avoid 2027’s shock CGT hike
news.summary: From setting up an SMSF or a company, to just leaving the country entirely, here are some strategies Australian Bitcoiners can employ to deal with 2027’s massive CGT hike.

news.title: Crypto's powerhouse super PAC suffers costly setback as Democrats sweep Congress
news.summary: The industry's primary campaign arm had cultivated a reputation as an unstoppable force, but more than a third of its spending failed to hit the mark, especially in Ohio.

news.title: Bitcoin rebounds past $80,000 as markets shrug off midterms and Binance hack
news.summary: Bitcoin rose 3.5% to $80,500 and ether jumped 6% after Democrats won Congress, while Bitwise says the Binance hack had limited market impact.

news.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
news.summary: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday, even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.

news.title: French Hill’s race still too close to call as House flips, changing the direction of crypto legislation
news.summary: As of Wednesday afternoon, House Financial Services Committee Chair French Hill's race for reelection is too close to call.

news.title: Riot shares surge on $28B AI lease as Hut 8 sinks on revenue miss
news.summary: Bitcoin miner Riot sold BTC to finance its AI expansion, while Hut 8 reported falling revenue and rising costs before its major data center leases generate income.

news.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
news.summary: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.

news.title: Coinbase says 99% of customer assets sit in cold storage after Binance’s $6.3 billion breach
news.summary: Coinbase says 99% of customer assets are in cold storage and it wasn't affected by the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

news.title: Schroders launches tokenized emerging markets debt fund on Solana with Centrifuge
news.summary: The $1 trillion-plus asset manager brings its emerging markets bond strategy to Solana, expanding the range of onchain actively managed funds.

news.title: U.S. Democratic sweep could be the final nail in the ‘Clarity Act’s coffin’
news.summary: Industry experts warn the Clarity Act is likely dead in its current form as incoming Democratic majorities eye tighter scrutiny of crypto markets and tokenized stocks.

news.title: Wall Street rethinks AI data center boom as Texas election raises new risks
news.summary: Bitcoin miners pivoting to AI face new uncertainty over power access and construction permits, while companies with approved projects could benefit from tighter supply.

news.title: Bitcoin hits $80.5K as US stocks rally on midterm election results
news.summary: Bitcoin climbed toward $80,500 as risk assets rallied on Democrats’ midterm election gains and oil prices fell.

news.title: Crypto Long & Short: ICE is betting on retail’s appetite for quick outcomes
news.summary: Retail traders increasingly want trades that resolve fast, from prediction markets to same-day options. Andy Baehr of GSR argues perpetual futures belong in that group, and that ICE’s deal to bring Trade[XYZ]’s Hyperliquid markets onshore is a play for that customer, one that doesn’t need a crypto…

news.title: The election changes Washington. The work on crypto continues
news.summary: The next Congress inherits an unfinished assignment: establishing clear, lasting rules for digital assets that protect consumers and ensure American innovation continues to thrive, writes Blockchain Association's Lindsay Fraser.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rises above $80,000 as stocks gain following Blue Wave
news.summary: The biggest losers were the AI data center stocks following victories for several candidates who campaigned expressly against the sector.

news.title: France backs reporting for self-custodied crypto worth 100K euros or more
news.summary: The amendment would require taxpayers to report holdings worth at least $112,000, but the measure still needs to survive the budget process.

news.title: Circle reports $865 million in Q3 revenue and reserve income, discloses 5% workforce reduction
news.summary: Circle reported $865 million in third-quarter revenue and reserve income and disclosed cuts affecting approximately 5% of its workforce.

news.title: Global asset manager Schroders brings emerging market bond fund to Solana
news.summary: The global asset manager, which oversees $1.1 trillion in assets, is bringing an actively managed bond strategy onchain through tokenization specialist Centrifuge.

news.title: THORChain's RUNE jumps 10% as North Korean hackers resume laundering Binance loot
news.summary: North Korea’s TraderTraitor is routing Binance hack proceeds through THORChain, swapping ether for bitcoin after an earlier wave of conversions from Tron.

news.title: Circle beats earnings expectations on strong revenue, but cuts 5% of its workforce
news.summary: Circle’s net income for continuing operations of $226 million grew 5% year-over-year to $226 million in the third quarter.

news.title: Here's how analysts are reacting to the new blue Congress
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 4, 2026

news.title: Canton’s CC rises 4% as SEC staff view it as ‘digital commodity’
news.summary: SEC staff’s no-action letter covers CC earned by running infrastructure and applications, but is not a binding ruling on its legal status.

news.title: BitGo launches institutional trading and financial solutions business led by former NYDIG executive
news.summary: BitGo has launched Global Markets, an institutional trading and financial solutions business headed by former NYDIG executive Pete Janney.

news.title: Binance hack may be ‘temporary setback’ for crypto, Grayscale’s Pandl says
news.summary: Zach Pandl highlighted institutional custody safeguards as crypto markets recovered some losses following the record $6.3 billion Binance hack.

news.title: DeFi Explained
news.summary: DeFi 201 explains decentralized finance as a connected protocol system. It follows how DEXs and AMMs, liquidity pools, lending markets, yield aggregators, oracles, derivatives and DAO governance fit together, and where composability creates systemic risk.

news.title: Bitcoin rebounds from midterm dip as DeFi leads gains
news.summary: Bitcoin recovered from a dip to around $75,600 as Democrats won Congress, while DeFi tokens led gains and Trump-linked coins fell.

news.title: Justin Sun seeks $264K sanctions over World Liberty’s UAE disclosure
news.summary: Sun plans to refile his token-freeze lawsuit in California state court after the sanctions motion is resolved. A hearing is set for Dec. 10.

news.title: ZachXBT names French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as suspected victim of $133 million crypto theft
news.summary: Blockchain sleuth ZachXBT says the French bank may have lost more than $133 million from crypto exchange accounts. Crypto.com confirms it has blocked funds linked to the theft.

news.title: Elon Musk floats space data centers as Democratic sweep puts pressure on AI trade
news.summary: Texas election result raises fears of data centre restrictions, while Musk and Palihapitiya draw attention to the space economy.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1.16B as Bitwise calls selling ‘short-term’
news.summary: Bitwise’s André Dragosch attributed Bitcoin ETF outflows to weaker market sentiment, saying institutions have largely maintained their exposure.

news.title: Morgan Stanley among first banks to tokenize US equities, Treasurys through DTCC’s service
news.summary: Morgan Stanley said it converted US equities and Treasurys into tokenized form through DTCC's new tokenization service.

news.title: US midterm elections 2026 as it happened: Democrats win control of Congress
news.summary: Democrats won control of Congress in the 2026 US midterms. Catch up on key races, crypto-backed candidates and the outlook for crypto regulation.

news.title: Morgan Stanley says it is among the first banks to tokenize real world assets
news.summary: The bank's announcement follows the launch of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation’s Tokenization Service, or DTS, on Oct. 28.

news.title: Binance hackers move 81% of stolen Solana, route funds via THORChain
news.summary: The Binance attackers moved most of the stolen SOL and continued laundering funds through THORChain after the protocol resumed swaps.

news.title: Zcash grants committee drops plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC to future mining rewards
news.summary: The committee withdrew its proposal after community backlash, leaving competing plans to cut off its funding or preserve the existing grants system.

news.title: Democrats win US House to secure control of Congress in midterms
news.summary: Democrats will take control of House committees in January 2027, giving them power to investigate President Donald Trump’s administration.

news.title: Bitcoin bounces from 7-week low under $76K as Democrats sweep Congress
news.summary: Bitcoin price downside reached a seven-week-low of $75,618 as 24-hour crypto long liquidations neared $300 million.

news.title: Bitcoin rises to $78,300 in V-shaped comeback as midterm election uncertainty fades
news.summary: Crypto prices reversed overnight losses following the Blue Wave landslide for the Democratic Party.

news.title: Jack Dorsey's Block faces $764 million DOJ settlement as bitcoin profit plunges 50%
news.summary: The proposed agreement would resolve a federal anti-money-laundering investigation, while lower Cash App trading fees halved Block's quarterly bitcoin gross profit.

news.title: Ethereum dev targets 2028 for quantum resistance, a year early
news.summary: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake said it is their “hope” that Ethereum will achieve its post-quantum and post-AI transition by December 2028.

news.title: U.S.-sanctioned Moscow Exchange to list bitcoin and Tether’s USDT in December
news.summary: Russia’s main bourse wants back the crypto trading Russians do abroad, and one of the coins it's listing is issued by a company that freezes wallets on the U.S. sanctions list.

news.title: French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa exploited for over $133 million, ZachXBT says
news.summary: ZachXBT said he has a 'high degree of confidence' that the attacker is not associated with North Korea's Lazarus Group.

news.title: Democrats claim control of the US Senate
news.summary: The shift in Senate control could change the path for the CLARITY Act, reshape committee leadership and bring closer scrutiny of Trump’s crypto businesses.

news.title: Former Sen. Sherrod Brown defeats Jon Husted, dealing a blow to crypto PAC Fairshake
news.summary: Former Democratic Sen. Sherrod Brown is taking back his spot in the Senate, leaving crypto political action committee Fairshake with the bag.

news.title: Block Inc. shares rise 6% after-hours as it raises full-year profit forecast
news.summary: Block raised its full-year gross profit forecast to $12.63 billion, which would represent a 22% year-on-year growth.

news.title: ZachXBT identifies French bank as alleged victim of $133M crypto theft
news.summary: The French bank has not confirmed its alleged involvement in the crypto theft, which ZachXBT said could have resulted in losses exceeding $133 million.

news.title: South Korea’s ruling party formally proposes deferral of crypto income tax
news.summary: The party leader stated that the country should first enact the Digital Asset Basic Act, a comprehensive legal framework for crypto.

news.title: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold
news.summary: Crypto executives expect US regulators to drive crypto policymaking regardless of the midterm election outcome.

news.title: SEC division views Canton Coin as digital commodity in no-action letter
news.summary: SEC's Division of Corporation Finance won't recommend enforcement over Canton Coin's programmatic issuance, calling CC a digital commodity.

news.title: CZ calls for crypto security alliance as AI-driven attacks accelerate after Binance hack
news.summary: In his first interview since the Binance hack, Changpeng Zhao says AI is accelerating cyberattacks and calls for industry security alliance.

news.title: Prediction markets bet on Democratic sweep of House, Senate in midterm elections
news.summary: Ahead of polls closing across the U.S., bettors on prediction markes are increasingly pricing in Democrats taking both the House and Senate.

news.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against World Liberty, alleging Trump-linked firm hid UAE ties
news.summary: Sun says World Liberty Financial hid its UAE citizenship to escape federal court, and plans to refile his $45M lawsuit in California state court.

news.title: CFTC approves individual stock perpetual futures trading in US for the first time
news.summary: The CFTC approved the ability for exchanges in the U.S. to offer perpetual futures contracts tied to individual stocks.
